geometry.exterior_color: natural beige unbleached molded plant fiber pulp
geometry.rim: wide flat perimeter sealing flange with uniform thickness for hermetic film sealing
geometry.base_panel: rectangular recessed base panel with smooth rounded corner transitions
geometry.wall_ribs: vertical scalloped ribs and structural fluting on the walls providing rigidity
geometry.corner_features: distinctive pyramid features in the corners for stacking strength and structural support
geometry.liner: smooth glossy white liner inside the cavity protecting fiber from moisture and fluids

markings.location: rectangular recessed base panel on the bottom of the tray
markings.additional_text: Cirkla branding and patent pending text debossed into the base panel floor

as_sold.film: tight clear modified atmosphere packaging (MAP) barrier film heat-sealed flush to the perimeter rim flange
as_sold.contents: raw fresh USDA Organic Grass Fed Angus Beef steak resting inside on an absorbent meat pad
as_sold.label_sleeve: vertical paper label wrap-around sleeve positioned over the left side of the tray featuring 'TRADER JOE'S', 'ORGANIC GRASS FED ANGUS BEEF', cut title in bold red, steer silhouette, and USDA Organic seal, leaving right half exposed to show marbled steak
as_sold.glare_notes: subtle, realistic specular glares and light streaks reflecting cold overhead store fluorescent tubes across the taut transparent film

must_keep: beige molded-fiber exterior with visible natural organic pressed fiber texture
rectangular recessed base panel with rounded transitions
vertical scalloped ribs along all four interior and exterior cavity walls
pyramid structural features molded into each of the four tray corners
smooth glossy white moisture-barrier liner inside the cavity
embossed CIRKLA mark on the base
size #5 dimensions (approx 10.28 x 8.08 inches, depth ~1.7 inches)
clear high-barrier MAP packaging film sealed tight flush to the rim
authentic Trader Joe's paper label sleeve covering left half of package
realistic hand scale and natural finger grip holding the tray
must_not: pen marks or handwritten ink (e.g., no 'ITC' ink on tray exterior)
white or gray exterior (exterior must strictly remain natural beige molded fiber)
extra compartments or divider walls (tray is single cavity only)
changed rim thickness, warped edges, or jagged perimeter flange
garbled embossing, gibberish lettering, or hallucinatory sleeve text
floating tray or physically impossible hand grip
wrong scale against the hand (tray must be proportional to 10.28 x 8.08 in size #5)

scale.hand_to_tray_notes: The tray measures 10.28 x 8.08 inches (#5 size). An adult human hand spans roughly 1/3 to 1/2 of the tray width. Fingers wrap naturally around the wide flat rim or support the underside base, never bending or warping the rigid pulp structure.

angle_views.front: Shows customer holding tray at chest level facing camera; paper sleeve on left, fresh raw beef on right, tight clear film with overhead light reflections, and natural beige rim perimeter.
angle_views.side: Shows the 1.7-inch wall profile, vertical scalloped ribs, uniform rim thickness, beige fiber underside, and fingers supporting the tray edges.
angle_views.top: Full planar view showing rectangular footprint with rounded corners, glossy white liner under meat cut, sleeve typography, and rim sealing surface.
angle_views.pov: First-person perspective looking down at two hands holding the meat package directly above a shopping cart or refrigerated grocery shelf.
angle_views.closeup: Macro shot focusing on molded fiber grain texture, embossed CIRKLA lettering and patent text on base, crisp typography on paper sleeve, or marble fat grain in the beef cut.

scene_defaults.camera: candid phone photo, modern smartphone camera snapshot (24-28mm equivalent lens), realistic shallow depth of field, authentic consumer mobile photo
scene_defaults.lighting: cold fluorescent store light, overhead retail supermarket commercial strip tubes casting specular glare bars across the tight plastic MAP film, with authentic soft ambient bounce from the white refrigerated deck and subtle contact shadows under fingers and tray
scene_defaults.imperfections: slight handheld tilt (2 to 8 degrees), natural phone camera optical softness, authentic non-studio mobile exposure, creased everyday casual clothing
scene_defaults.skin: natural unretouched skin, authentic uneven skin tone, visible pores, slight shine on forehead and nose, flyaway hair, natural fingernails without airbrushing
scene_defaults.framing: candid handheld framing in front of the consistent Trader Joe's refrigerated multi-tier meat display case with authentic signage ('RIBEYE Steak', 'Center CUT FILET', and 'FEARLESS FLYER' red-and-white price tags), natural shopper browsing posture, consistent refrigerated meat aisle background

front_chest.pose: Candid shopper browsing in front of the refrigerated meat display case, holding the tray naturally at chest or waist height while inspecting meat cuts
front_chest.camera_distance: Medium candid shot (about 3 to 4 feet away)
front_chest.tray_orientation: Held naturally tilted slightly back toward camera (approx 15-30 degrees) showcasing packaging face
front_chest.what_the_camera_sees: Shopper holding tray naturally, authentic Trader Joe's paper label sleeve, fresh raw marbled steak, glossy film sheen, and consistent refrigerated meat cooler with 'RIBEYE Steak' and 'Center CUT FILET' signage in the background

pov_hands.pose: First-person point-of-view of shopper's hands extending into frame holding the meat package
pov_hands.tray_orientation: Held horizontally tilted slightly upward toward viewer's eye line
pov_hands.what_the_camera_sees: Shopper's hands gripping tray edges, clear sleeve graphics, raw beef marbling under tight film, and refrigerated display below

side_profile.pose: Shopper viewed from a 45-degree angle holding tray while inspecting it
side_profile.tray_orientation: Angled at 45 degrees revealing side wall depth and scalloped ribs
side_profile.what_the_camera_sees: Side profile of tray with scalloped ribs and rim thickness, hand fingers supporting base, shopper profile, and store shelves

cart_topdown.pose: Shopper placing the packaged meat tray into a red wire Trader Joe's shopping cart
cart_topdown.camera_distance: High-angle top-down (about 2 to 3 feet directly above cart)
cart_topdown.tray_orientation: Flat horizontal in cart or angled against other groceries
cart_topdown.what_the_camera_sees: Top-down view of tray packaging, glossy film highlight, cart wire mesh, other groceries, and shopper's hand releasing grip

closeup_hands.pose: Close-up macro shot of hands holding tray, thumbs resting firmly on the wide rim flange
closeup_hands.tray_orientation: Tilted 20 degrees showcasing corner pyramid features and embossed markings
closeup_hands.what_the_camera_sees: High detail on molded fiber texture, thumb grip on rim, clear film sheen, label text, and corner structural pyramids

stepped_back_wide.pose: Shopper standing in the supermarket aisle viewed from a distance, positioned in the lower third of the composition holding the tray at waist or chest level
stepped_back_wide.camera_distance: Stepped-back wide shot (about 5 to 8 feet away)
stepped_back_wide.tray_orientation: Held horizontally or slightly angled in the lower third of frame
stepped_back_wide.what_the_camera_sees: Full upper-body and torso of shopper in lower third of frame, expansive meat aisle shelving above, refrigerated meat case, aisle floor, and overhead store lighting

seated_in_cart_view.pose: Camera viewing from inside the shopping cart child seat or basket looking across and up as the tray is inspected or placed into the cart
seated_in_cart_view.camera_distance: Medium-close low-angle perspective (about 2 to 3 feet from inside cart)
seated_in_cart_view.tray_orientation: Tilted forward slightly above cart wire handlebar and basket perimeter
seated_in_cart_view.what_the_camera_sees: Red wire cart rim and handlebar in lower foreground, shopper holding the Cirkla tray package, store shelves behind

holding_and_pointing.pose: One hand holding the tray firmly by the rim or underside, and the second hand pointing to or touching the Trader Joe's paper label sleeve
holding_and_pointing.tray_orientation: Held at chest height tilted 15-25 degrees toward camera to highlight paper label sleeve
holding_and_pointing.what_the_camera_sees: One hand gripping tray rim, index finger of other hand resting on label typography, clear view of raw steak marbling and USDA Organic badge

off_center_candid.pose: Shopper positioned casually in the left third or right third of the frame, holding tray while browsing
off_center_candid.camera_distance: Medium candid shot (about 3 to 4.5 feet away)
off_center_candid.tray_orientation: Held naturally at waist/chest height, shifted off-center following rule-of-thirds
off_center_candid.what_the_camera_sees: Off-center subject in left or right third, extensive view of supermarket aisle and shelves filling the opposite two-thirds of frame

tilted_handheld.pose: Authentic candid handheld snapshot with a deliberate 5 to 15 degree camera tilt (Dutch angle), shopper holding tray in aisle
tilted_handheld.tray_orientation: Tilted along diagonal camera axis, showing dynamic packaging perspective
tilted_handheld.what_the_camera_sees: Dynamic diagonal composition with 5-15 degree handheld tilt, shopper holding tray, misaligned shelf edges and store lights

cropped_edges.pose: Casual framing with edges intentionally cropped (shopper's shoulder, elbow, or outer hand partly out of frame)
cropped_edges.camera_distance: Medium-close candid snapshot (about 2.5 to 3.5 feet away)
cropped_edges.what_the_camera_sees: Partial crop where shopper's hand or shoulder extends beyond frame boundary, authentic unposed snapshot aesthetic

shelf_gaze.pose: Shopper looking down at the tray or looking across at the refrigerated shelf rather than at the camera, absorbed in inspecting meat options
shelf_gaze.camera_distance: Medium candid shot (about 3 to 4 feet away)
shelf_gaze.what_the_camera_sees: Three-quarter candid profile of shopper looking at tray or shelf tags, tray packaging held at chest level, supermarket aisle context
